items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs NO due to hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring from W1; limited Fri but downgraded Sat
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; secondary WRs elevated

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practices.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; Texans WR volume opens

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT or DOUBTFUL (knee) for Week 2; Raiders elevated Myarick/White.
items.why: Post-meniscus; limited Fri practice, GTD test
items.implication: Plan without; late TE streamer needed
items.opportunity: TE snaps to Myarick/Mayer; WR Cody White

items.text: Rams list Puka Nacua questionable (hip/groin soreness post-Thu practice) for MNF vs NYG; no Sat practice; Whittington doubtful.
items.why: Groin soreness different from camp; McVay GTD
items.implication: Have pivot for MNF; Adams bump if out

items.text: Joe Burrow listed Q (back) but expected to play vs HOU; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson.
items.why: Back soreness; said 'ridiculous' not to play; Taylor positive
items.opportunity: Full CIN pass game if active

items.text: Steelers downgraded Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) for Sunday vs NE.
Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest injury on slate; Q after limited Fri, impacts Herbert projections heavily; 4pm ET start.
items.implication: Monitor inactives closely; Herbert downgrade if out
items.opportunity: If out: Johnston/QJ volume spike; LAC pace

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for 2026 debut; Patriots need playmakers.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential per Levitan; NE RB committee

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Week 2; expected back.
items.opportunity: Kamara 3-down; Etienne early-down split with Miller

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in debut vs Stevenson?
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, 40% route targets W1 (team lead); IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft run matchup

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 util score W1 (tied Bijan), 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches recent.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes W1, 69% pts via air; Kamara back squeezes role; underdog script.
items.why: W1 committee + Kamara return + poor script

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career w/ Wentz; CHI soft vs WR.
